nodes.title: Admit the character

workflow.description: A written brief, or a character's parts, in; one rigged, reviewed character at game scale out. Agents draw reference pictures, Tripo builds a textured mesh of each part from them, an agent stands the parts up as one character in Blender, and the skeleton comes from Tripo or from an agent. Independent reviewers judge every stage on renders, and the character is admitted only when its numbers and its pictures both pass. An assembly or rig still rejected after its own takes rebuilds the body, a bounded number of times.
